notes: scripts v5: fixes the WebUI stop/restart freeze. The WebUI buttons are fixed command strings that run stop_qqbot.sh synchronously; the v4 stop took many seconds on a real phone (pidfile group-kill sleeps, up to ~6 full /proc sweep enumerations forking tr+grep per process, then non-lazy unmount attempts that can block on busy bind mounts while QQ/NapCat are still dying), and while that exec ran the WebUI host bridge was occupied: the page froze, status/QR polls piled up, and the user had to force-clear the manager app 2-3 times before it would open again. v5 changes: (1) stop_qqbot.sh invoked without arguments detaches: it re-executes itself with setsid in the background (log: /data/qqbot/logs/stop.log), prints a stopping-in-background line and exits 0 immediately, so the WebUI bridge is free at once; callers that need synchronous completion (uninstall.sh) pass --inline. (2) The real stop is faster: the shared sweep block (stop_qqbot.sh and updater.sh, byte-identical) classifies bots and watchdogs in ONE /proc enumeration per round with in-shell exact-token matching (same semantics as v4: a token exactly /root/qqbot/bot.js with node in argv[0], or exactly /root/qqbot/start-bot.sh with sh in argv[0]; decoys that merely mention the paths never match), at most 2 rounds of TERM, 1s, KILL, and unmounts are lazy-only (umount -l) so a busy mount can never block the stop. (3) Stop's inline run sets a start-tick guard so processes started after the stop began are skipped: a watchdog/bot freshly launched by the WebUI restart or clear-login flow is never killed by the still-running sweep. The updater does not set the guard and sweeps exactly as before, still relaunching exactly one watchdog after a bot swap or rollback. bot stays v6: ranked candidate fallthrough (up to 3 candidates tried silently; dead_source, failed, blocked, or link-less candidates are skipped for the next; the group sees one searching message plus the final link or one honest all-sources-failed reply), empty-search retry (up to 2 re-runs at ~6s gaps), 21:00-23:59 Asia/Shanghai digest poster, single-instance lock, message_id dedup, video-over-novel pick.
